episodes.title: Crepe Day
episodes.summary: Best friends Bobby and Romy are convinced their town is harboring evil and go hunting for monsters.

episodes.title: The Twerpminator
episodes.summary: A swamp monster is after Bobby, as is a fierce warrior, who is convinced he's a threat to Ouimper.

episodes.title: Bad Connection
episodes.summary: The gang must find the Ragatta Rock, which could hold the answers to Bobby's curse.

episodes.title: Nosfera…Who?
episodes.summary: Bobby is determined to prove his suspicion that his aunt's date is hiding a dark secret.

episodes.title: This Party Is Dead
episodes.summary: It's Ouimper's annual spook fest, but Kim has mysteriously disappeared. Has she been Kim‐napped?

episodes.title: Night of the Fishing Dead
episodes.summary: Things get out of hand when the local arcade is invaded by zombie fish.

episodes.title: The Missing Link
episodes.summary: The gang venture to an island off the coast of Ouimper rumored to be linked to Mordam.

episodes.title: Momster
episodes.summary: Bobby tries to come to terms with his impending doom and uses a summoning stone to invoke his mom.

episodes.title: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.summary: It's a race against time as our heroes try to save Bobby from the evil curse.

episodes.title: Knight Terrors
episodes.summary: Bobby's curse is lifted, but a new threat arises in Ouimper as ancient ghost knights target Kim.

episodes.title: Happy Doomsday Everyone
episodes.summary: Our heroes try to stop Mordam before she releases Primal Evil upon the world.

episodes.title: Hair Raising
episodes.summary: A werewolf bite leaves Kim feeling her usually supressed feelings. Can Bobby and Romy help her?

episodes.title: Terror Cruise
episodes.summary: Doug's car is possessed by evil, and turns Romy against Bobby. Will their friendship survive?

episodes.title: Lighthouse of Horrors
episodes.summary: Kim is having her first-ever party, but trouble is afoot as meddling mermaids crash the fun.

episodes.title: Season of the Witch
episodes.summary: Evil witches and a new Light Keeper threaten unity, testing friendships and dividing the group.

episodes.title: Residence Evil
episodes.summary: Bobby and Romy turn to their favorite terror tour brochure writer for answers about evil in Ouimper.

episodes.title: Sub-Terror
episodes.summary: Kim searches for Doug in Subterra while Bobby and Romy uncover suspicious activity in town.

episodes.title: Mind Games
episodes.summary: An evil board game intensifies rivalry and disrupts Romy's plan to stop the Mayor.

episodes.title: Nevermore
episodes.summary: The gang are on trial and must confess their darkest secrets, but one secret threatens all.

episodes.title: The Kids Are All Fright
episodes.summary: Mordam returns, but for her grand plan to work, she must break Bobby's will once and for all.

episodes.title: Scream Time
episodes.summary: Eviltanium is unleashed upon Ouimper, zombifying all the inhabitants.

episodes.title: Grand Designs
episodes.summary: Our heroes must unite in order to confront their most formidable challenge yet.
